summary: Frontend-only smoke + integration test of Pharma360 Expo web app against LIVE external API https://pharma360benak.com/api. Verified Home, Catalogue (search + category chips), Product detail, Cart persistence, Checkout (wilaya sheet + dynamic delivery fee), Auth (login), Compte guest + logged-in, Fidélité, Commandes (/orders/mine), Blog, Pharmacie. Login with test credentials succeeds and profile 'App Test' + existing order 'KFK 444 DA' are shown. Add-to-cart via text works (button lacks a testID). No order was actually posted to prod DB. Overall app is functional and design matches teal-blue + cream theme from /settings.

ui_bugs.issue: Sticky 'Ajouter au panier' button has no testID (works via visible text 'Ajouter au panier'). Add testID='add-to-cart' for reliable automated testing.
Login screen 'Se connecter' submit button and inputs have no testID (guessable via label text but not robust). Recommend testID='login-identifier', 'login-password', 'login-submit'.

integration_issues.issue: Console warning: 'The action GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' when landing directly on /auth/login. If user deep-links to login (or after logout), back navigation may not work. Consider router.replace after auth or a safe fallback that pushes to '/'.

issues: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' from some react-native-web element (likely LinearGradient/ScrollView). Migrate to style.pointerEvents when possible.
Warning 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported' shows on multiple screens — expected on web, but ensure animation performance is acceptable on device.

action_items: Add testID='add-to-cart' to the sticky 'Ajouter au panier' button in app/produit/[id].tsx.
Add testID to auth screens: 'login-identifier', 'login-password', 'login-submit' in app/auth/login.tsx, and equivalents in app/auth/register.tsx.

Handle direct-open navigation to /auth/login (deep-link/logout) by replacing history or providing a fallback back handler so 'GO_BACK' warning disappears and the back button always returns to a real screen.
Address deprecation warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — audit components that pass pointerEvents as a prop (likely LinearGradient absolute overlays) and move it to the style prop.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts correctly uses EXPO_PUBLIC_PHARMA_API_URL from env and captures set-cookie access_token for native — good.
Cart state persisted via storage keys ('pharma_cart') and reflected across tabs — verified working (badge '1' on tab bar).
Checkout /orders POST body matches API_MAP.md contract; wilaya fee is dynamically read from /delivery/wilayas — verified UI updates from 500 → 400 DA on Chlef.
GET /orders/mine used correctly for customer orders (not admin /orders) — verified working after login.
Home hero, promos, categories, brands, blog all populated from live API and dynamic theme (bleu poudré/crème) is applied — verified.

success_rate.backend: N/A (external live API, not in scope)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (11/11 tested screens work)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing customer test account and did NOT place a real order in prod DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App calls live external API https://pharma360benak.com/api directly. Do NOT actually submit checkout (it writes to prod DB). Test credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Preview URL: https://pharma360-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com. Add-to-cart on product page is currently only reachable via visible text 'Ajouter au panier' unless main agent adds testID='add-to-cart'.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. Only minor gaps: missing testIDs on product/auth CTAs and a deep-link back-navigation warning on /auth/login. Root cause of missing testIDs: components were written before test hooks were added; recommend a testID pass over all interactive CTAs.
